properties.notes: Proposed potential site in the emerging New Milton Neighbourhood Plan (April 2018: http://www.newmiltonplan.org.uk/2018-theplan/towncentre.html). Given its town centre location, the site could accommodate a high density mixed-use scheme comprising commercial uses on the ground floor and residential uses on upper floors. Redevelopment would have potential to bring visual/economic/social enhancements. Around 35 dwellings
